description.zh:
要删除静态页面缓存自定义规则的域名。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名。
description.en:
The domain name for which you want to delete the custom rules of the Static Page Caching policy.

> You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all the domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh: 要删除的规则的名称列表。
description.en: An array consisting of the names of the rules that you want to delete.

title.zh: 删除网站业务静态页面缓存的自定义规则

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于批量删除网站业务静态页面缓存的自定义规则。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the DeleteWebCacheCustomRule operation to delete the custom rules of the Static Page Caching policy for a website.

### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-web-cache-custom-rule --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --rule-names doc-test-rule --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
